context: Finding: Athena engine v3 supports Apache Iceberg natively (format v2) via the Glue Data Catalog: CREATE TABLE with table_type ICEBERG, CTAS, MERGE INTO, VACUUM, time travel. Engine v2 has no Iceberg support. BenchBox gap: benchbox/platforms/athena.py renders only STORED AS PARQUET/TEXTFILE external DDL (_convert_to_external_table) and has no Iceberg DDL path, engine-version check, or table_type handling. Recommendation: add an Iceberg DDL branch to the Athena adapter (CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ... TBLPROPERTIES table_type=ICEBERG) gated on engine v3; Spark-side Iceberg is covered separately. No live verification possible without AWS credentials.
